rv.q: And yet their words, and the power of the acting in this Invictus show, delivers the story viscerally, bringing this reviewer to tears, to cry out in woe, to bury my head in my arms.
None of this minutia diminishes from the power of the play and this production, which is devastating.
There is a powerful scene in Act two where we see just how strong an actress Ms Gardner is. You need to see it for yourself, but she is terrific.

cn.t: Invictus Theatre delivers powerful performances in Nottage's Pulitzer-winning "Ruined," tackling the brutal subject of sexual violence in the Congo with exceptional acting that showcases some of Chicago's finest talent.
